title: This Week in the Wiki, 5 November 2026
description: Welcome to This Week in the Wiki. This is the weekly brief from the Economics of AI wiki, and it is a big one, because it covers two batches of new material: the twenty-ninth of October and the fifth of November. Thirty-four new sources. Where do we start?

title: The Papers, 5 November 2026
description: Welcome to the papers edition of This Week in the Wiki. This one is built differently. Instead of a tour of what changed in the wiki, we take the week's papers one at a time, three or four minutes each, the shorter items in a minute, and then we try to put it together at the end. Two batches this week, the twenty-ninth of October and the fifth of November, so this is a long one. Nine papers. Let us start with the one in your field.
